requirements: R1: Reconcile internal task status with actual GitHub PR state when PR is closed without merge to prevent tasks from being falsely marked as done

slices.title: Patch task status synchronization for unmerged PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub status reconciliation for this epic, I want to update the synchronization logic to check if a closed PR was actually merged, so that tasks with unmerged closed PRs are not falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task linked to a GitHub PR
When the PR is closed on GitHub but not merged
Then the synchronization process must not mark the internal task as 'done'
Then integration tests must verify the correct status handling of unmerged closed PRs
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' task statuses due to unmerged PRs to 0
